invalidation.reason: The evaluator required a literal author-written comment prefix even though the user request specified the deployment audit outcome, not that exact natural-language phrase. All four trajectories completed every authoritative migration, artifact, deployment, release, issue, milestone, preservation and exactly-once check and created a semantically equivalent verification note containing the target version and approved digest.

objective_rescore.rule: A verification note is valid when exactly one rollout-issue comment contains both the target version and approved artifact digest, independent of prose template.

corrective_change.instruction: The user request now explicitly requires one verification note identifying the deployed version and approved artifact digest.
corrective_change.evaluator: The deterministic check now matches those two objective identifiers instead of an exact phrase.
